report: Candidate layers for the holes in why-not.json: NPS National Register points + polygons (state historic sites / 'National Historic Site' names that are not NPS units), USFS trails, BLM national historic/scenic trail lines, and every sub-layer of the BLM national recreation service (we only read /9; the site points/polygons may sit in 0-8). Want: answers, geometry, name field, count.
